original_test_intent: Read one existing BMC session record through IB using the correct normal, FE-handle or FF-ID request form without creating or changing session state.
original_method: Use raw 0x06/0x3d on an approved existing session, validate selector-specific framing, decode/redact fields and correlate with protected inventory.
manual_activity: Engineer validates request/response forms and redaction once; no point-of-action approval is needed for the bounded read.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative; raw command is known, while selector-specific parser/reference remain readiness inputs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact normal/FE/FF request for one existing session with bounded output and redaction.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select an existing authorized session, issue the exact form, validate identity/framing, decode/redact fields and compare with inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes session-activation prerequisite and unsafe credential/log handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB read remains required; no session-control coverage claimed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong FE/FF form can return another session; fields contain sensitive identity metadata.

project_override_considerations: Alternate readers must expose the same session identity and fields on the intended IB path; inventory-only or OOB-only coverage must be disclosed.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure merely says ensure a session is active and Criteria only checks command success; neither prevents creating state nor requires selector/identity/field validation for sensitive session data.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read command and selector modes are defined; session choice/schema/redaction are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents creating a session just to inspect it and turns transport success into selector-aware, identity-correlated session evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The operation is read-only when applied to an existing authorized session. Normal, FE and FF forms change the request identity, so deterministic automation must validate the chosen form and redact the response rather than simply accepting completion.
